dimensions.semantics: Distance between intersections along the mean-normal line through the stated source reference. Nonparallel planes have no unique global separation; this is not a proven room dimension.
dimensions.uncertainty_note: Joint plane covariance includes shared calibration. Add the reference-location standard-deviation contribution conservatively because reference/geometry cross-covariance is not separately retained; do not interpret as a calibrated confidence interval.
